why: D788-02 made the Community Port's published minimum a DERIVED number. A derived number still needs a floor that can REFUSE it, and the only floor that is a property of this board rather than of a wish is the tightest published minimum supply voltage among the parts the BOARD ITSELF powers from /ACC_3V3_SW. On this board that part is U16.
